upgrade_cutter_1_d: Each cut removes twice as much debris.
upgrade_tech_assembly_d: Unlocks the Assembler and new contracts.
upgrade_link_rate_d: Belts run at twice the speed.
upgrade_tech_cryo_d: Unlocks ice extraction, coolant and cryo modules.
upgrade_tech_rail_d: Unlocks stations, rails and trains: reach the rich deposits to the northeast.
upgrade_tech_shuttle_d: Travel to Mars and unlock its industry: silicon, wafers, radiators and cargo pads.
event_hint: Abandoned branch line southeast of the base: clear the shadow scrap and move cargo by train.
err_need_stats: The contract's conditions are not met yet.
objective_o_clear: Hold left click with the Multitool ({tool_cutter}) on 3 scrap piles: they give material and credits.
objective_o_recycle: Deposit the scrap in the Recycler ({interact_insert}) and collect 8 recovered material ({interact_take}): machines are built with it.
objective_o_extractor: Cut the ice crust from an ore deposit and place an Extractor ({tool_build}): it mines ore on its own.
objective_o_smelter: Place a Smelter near the Extractor ({tool_build}): it turns ore into ingots, which are worth far more.
objective_o_link: With the Belt ({tool_link}), join extractor → smelter → terminal: the orange arrow is the output and the blue ones are inputs. The line will then run on its own.
objective_o_ingots: Let the line produce 10 ingots: meanwhile, you can open another deposit or keep recycling.
objective_o_sell: Sell ingots in the Export terminal panel ({interact_panel}) until you earn 50 credits: auto-sell does it for you.
objective_o_contract: Hand in 10 ingots for the “First ingot shipment” contract ({tech}): it pays far more than selling them.
objective_o_assembly: Buy Assembly technology ({tech}): it opens machine parts, worth more than their ingots.
objective_o_parts: Place an Assembler ({tool_build}), feed it ingots by Belt ({tool_link}) and produce 8 parts: the train needs them.
objective_o_rail_tech: Buy the Railway licence ({tech}): the rich deposits to the northeast yield 2.5 times more.
objective_o_station: Place two Stations ({tool_build}), one by the factory and one by the rich deposits: at that distance, a train carries more than a Belt.
objective_o_train: Join the stations with rails ({tool_rail}), create a train in their panel ({interact_panel}) and deliver 40 units: rich ore now reaches your factory.
objective_o_mars: Travel to Mars from the Shuttle terminal ({interact}).
objective_o_silicon: Clear a Martian deposit and place a Silicon extractor ({tool_build}).
objective_o_wafer: Refine 15 wafers. On Mars, whatever generates heat runs slower without cooling.
objective_o_radiator: Build a Radiator: check the Heat line at the top left.
objective_o_pad: Build a Cargo pad on each planet, set one to SEND and ship cargo.
objective_o_nav: Bring cryo modules from Pluto and make 3 Navigation cores.
objective_done: Ninth Planet Project completed! Pluto is an industrial world again. Keep optimizing your factory.

pad_mode_receive: Mode: RECEIVES cargo from the other planet
